title: home-customer.v1
description: What a person's Vexa knows about them as a customer, kept beside each home composition and NEVER rendered as cards. Read by the person's own agent (tool customer_profile) and by the next home composition, which updates it from new evidence and outcomes and records what changed and why. User-scoped; ids and short summaries only, never copied mail, transcript or page content. The person can see and correct any field (customer_correct): a correction wins over anything inferred until they correct it again. Retention follows the company policy home_history_retention_days.

value.description: the field's content: short summaries, counts, ids

evidence.description: ids of what this rests on (cards, events, meetings, chats, curriculum steps), or 'corrected by the person'

fields.description: stage {stage, why} · capabilities {adopted, not_yet} (curriculum ids, done from usage evidence) · jobs / goals [{job, evidence}] · patterns (meeting load, chats, routines, active hours) · preferences {weights per kind and person, acted, dismissed} · friction [{id, what, resolved}] · open_loops [{card, title}] · health {state: healthy|drifting|blocked, why} · next_best_actions [{card, kind, hypothesis, metric}] · experiments [{at, shown, stage, mix, result}] · transitions [{from, to, at, why}] (stage changes, with their evidence, from _global/lifecycle.md)
